title: KRCL Recruitment 2026 – Assistant Loco Pilot, Senior Assistant Loco Pilot Posts
shortInfo: KRCL has announced notification for Assistant Loco Pilot, Senior Assistant Loco Pilot posts. Required qualification: ITI. Last date to apply: 19-10-26.

dates.event: Application Submission Last Date (Through Proper Channel)
KRCL Exemption from Immediate Absorption Rule Upto

howToApply: Applicants must submit the complete filled-in application in the prescribed format (Annexure A) to their Administrative Officer (HQ/Board etc.) for forwarding to the Chief Personnel Officer, Konkan Railway Corporation Ltd.
The forwarding authority must indicate No Objection, Vigilance, and DAR Clearance, and mention APAR gradings of the candidate for the last five years.

Applications through proper channel should reach: Chief Personnel Officer, Konkan Railway Corporation Ltd., 4th floor, Belapur Bhavan Plot no. 6, Sector-11, C.B.D Belapur, Navi Mumbai, Pin-400614 on or before 22.10.2026 at 17:00 hrs.
An advance copy with all enclosures may also be forwarded via email to spo.gnandeep@krcl.co.in on or before 19.10.2026 at 17:00 hrs.
Eligible applicants will be short-listed on the basis of eligibility and experience as per the Vacancy Notice.

howToApply: Download the prescribed application form (Annexure-1) from the advertisement.

title: GSSC Recruitment 2026 – Desktop Publishing Operator, Lower Division Clerk/Recovery Clerk, Data Entry Operator, Junior Assistant Posts
shortInfo: GSSC has announced notification for Desktop Publishing Operator, Lower Division Clerk/Recovery Clerk, Data Entry Operator, Junior Assistant posts. Required qualification: Higher Secondary School Certificate. Last date to apply: 02-10-26.
howToApply: Candidates shall fill the Application form through online mode only as available on Commission’s website https://gssc.goa.gov.in.
The candidate shall apply for the post within the time limit prescribed.

General instructions for filling of the Application form are available on the Commission’s website. All candidates are required to read instructions carefully before filling up the online application.
Candidates are instructed to go through the syllabus and scheme of examination for the posts published on the website of the Commission.
The Commission shall shortlist/select candidates on merit, based on marks obtained in Computer Based Test (CBT) examination.
Candidates shall upload a recent passport-size photograph while submitting the online application.

The candidate should ensure they possess the requisite educational qualification, valid 15 years residence certificate issued by the Competent authority in Goa, registration with the Employment Exchange Goa/valid Employment registration Card, Birth certificate, Caste/Social Status certificate, Disabilities certificate, EWS Certificate, Experience Certificate, Ex-Servicemen Certificate, Diploma/Course Certificate in Computer and all other documents/certificates as mentioned in the Advertisement.
Application fee is to be paid through online payment using Internet Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI. No physical payments will be allowed.

title: GSL Recruitment 2026 – Trainee Project Executive Posts
shortInfo: GSL has announced notification for Trainee Project Executive posts. Required qualification: B.Tech/B.E, CA, B.Sc. Last date to apply: 03-10-26.
howToApply: Visit the official website www.goashipyard.in and navigate to Notice Board – Careers – Advertisement.
Click on ‘GSL Careers’ and then click ‘Apply Now’ button and select the post you wish to apply for.
Read the eligibility criteria and Terms & Conditions before applying.

Keep scanned copies of required documents ready (Passport size photograph, Signature, SSC certificate, Educational qualification mark sheet & degree, Caste/Disability certificate, Experience certificates, Aadhar Card).
Fill in the Online Application Form with all required personal and educational details.

Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/- (Non-Refundable) online through SBI e-pay (debit card/credit card/net banking). SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen/GSL graduate apprentices/GSL Advance trainees are exempted from fee.
Download and take a print of the Fee Receipt on successful payment.
After completion, take a mandatory print out of the auto-generated filled-in Application Form for use in subsequent selection process.
Online Application opens from 00.00 hrs on 04.09.2026 and closes at 17.00 hrs on 03.10.2026.

fees.fee: Rs. 1180/- (Refunded after appearing in CBT, deducting bank charges)

dates.event: Online Application Window Opens (Last week of August 2026 (tentative; exact date to be published 7 days in advance)

howToApply: Visit the official KRCL website: www.konkanrailway.com
Register your name on the official website to generate a Registration Number and Password (link goes live in the last week of August 2026).
Use the registration number and password sent to your registered email and mobile to access the application form.
Fill in all required details carefully including post preference, domicile/land loser/employment exchange status, and personal information.
Upload scanned passport-size photograph (JPEG, 30–70 KB), signature (JPEG, 30–70 KB), and other required documents.
Pay the prescribed examination fee online via Internet Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI.
Submit the application and keep a printed copy for future reference.
Note your Registration Number for further stages of the recruitment process.
For queries, email: helpdskrectcell@krcl.co.in (active only till closing date of application).
